finding.rationale: The closure_window leaf permits closure within at most 7 working days. The source tests WS-CONSENT-DAYS > 7 and then sets WS-ACTION to CLOSE, so the transition occurs after the allowed limit and is late.

trajectory.final_answer: The clause requires closure within 7 working days, but the source reaches CLOSE only when WS-CONSENT-DAYS > 7. That comparator puts the transition after the deadline, supporting D5_boundary_error.
